method: Apple LLVM Mach-O arm64 disassembly removes instruction addresses and symbolizes calls and local branches. Normalize calls to the same Mach-O stub target. Normalize adjacent page/offset pairs only when the linked symbol, full C string, 4096 destination bytes in __TEXT,__const, or exact loaded bytes match. Resolve loader-declared rebases when comparing data-constant records, including their pointees, nested supertrait vtables and unchanged scalar fields. Retain all other operands, including stack and field offsets and unresolved linked page destinations. Resolve each selected vtable method slot to its linked symbol and read the size and alignment from its header.
native_plan: ProjectionExec: expr=[id@0 as id, approx_percentile_cont(bench.d, Float64(0.5)) PARTITION BY [bench.grp] ORDER BY [bench.id ASC NULLS LAST] ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW@3 as value]

BoundedWindowAggExec: wdw=[approx_percentile_cont(bench.d, Float64(0.5)) PARTITION BY [bench.grp] ORDER BY [bench.id ASC NULLS LAST] ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW: Field { "approx_percentile_cont(bench.d, Float64(0.5)) PARTITION BY [bench.grp] ORDER BY [bench.id ASC NULLS LAST] ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW": nullable Float64 }, frame: ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW], mode=[Sorted]
SortExec: expr=[grp@1 ASC NULLS LAST, id@0 ASC NULLS LAST], preserve_partitioning=[false]
